# Cabins in the Ozarks

> Cabins in the Ozarks: Little Switzerland's historic cabins and Morwood House, two places to stay on Scenic Byway 7 in Jasper, Arkansas, near the Buffalo National River and the Arkansas Grand Canyon.

Owner: Matt Mowen. Phone: (870) 416-2383. Email: mmowen213@gmail.com. Book direct on the sites below.

## Properties
- Little Switzerland Cabins (https://littleswitzerlandarkansas.com): 5 rentals on Scenic Byway 7, 2.5 miles north of Jasper, Arkansas 72641. Homestead dating to 1891. Cabin 1 (sleeps 4, 2 queens, from $100), Cabin 2 (sleeps 2, king, renovated Dec 2025, from $110), Room 3 (sleeps 2, queen, from $85), Room 4 (sleeps 2, queen, from $90), Room 5 (sleeps 4, queen + 2 twins, balcony, from $95). No full kitchens (mini fridge, microwave, coffee maker). Dogs welcome, $25 per pet. Shared pavilion, grills, fire pit. Airbnb ratings 4.69 to 4.77.
- Morwood House (https://morwoodhouse.com): 2,400 sq ft home on 15 private acres, 1 mile south of Jasper off Highway 7. 3 bedrooms (3 queens) plus sleeper sofa, 2 baths, sleeps 8. Hot tub facing the sunset, game room with pool and ping pong tables built from about 27 local wood species, full kitchen, fireplace, washer/dryer, EV charger. From $205 a night. 9.6/10 on VRBO from 222 reviews.
- Combined: up to 22 guests. Check in 4 PM, check out 11 AM.

## Nearby
Buffalo National River, Arkansas Grand Canyon overlook, Lost Valley Trail, Boxley Valley elk, Hawksbill Crag, Mystic Caverns, downtown Jasper. Branson and Eureka Springs about an hour away.
